bins.name: Special handling
bins.accepts: Not in any bin: batteries, e-waste, scrap metal

prep: Empty and give it a light rinse
Put it in loose, not in a bag
plastic_bottle.why: Bottles are accepted with caps on.

plastic_container.why: Plastic containers, clamshells and tubs are accepted.

plastic_cup.why: Plastic cups are recyclable; foam cups are not.

plastic_lid_cap.why: Caps and lids, including coffee cup lids, are accepted.

prep: Better: reuse it or use a store take-back
Never in the blue bin, loose or as a liner
plastic_bag_film.why: Plastic bags and film are landfill in SF and a top contaminant in blue bins.

snack_wrapper.why: Shiny food wrappers and chip bags are landfill.

prep: Clean foam blocks: Recology transfer station
foam.why: Styrofoam is on the landfill list.

prep: Wood or bamboo utensils go in the green bin
plastic_utensil_straw.why: Plastic utensils can go in the recycling bin.

prep: Shredded paper: sealed, labeled paper bag
paper.why: Clean, dry paper, mail and magazines are recyclable.

paper_bag.why: Clean paper bags are recyclable; soiled ones are compostable.

prep: Extra boxes: break down and bundle beside the cart

pizza_box.why: Greasy pizza boxes go in compost, not recycling.

soiled_paper.why: Napkins, paper towels, tissues and soiled paper are compostable.

prep: Sleeve and plastic lid can stay on
paper_cup.why: Empty paper coffee cups are recyclable in SF.

carton.why: Milk, juice and other cartons are recyclable.

metal_can.why: Aluminum and steel cans are recyclable.

prep: Ball it up, up to softball size
aluminum_foil.why: Aluminum foil and trays are recyclable.

prep: Check SF Environment's spray can page before tossing
aerosol_can.why: SF lists spray cans for special handling; SF's recyclables list shows empty ones as recyclable.

prep: Pots, pans and other scrap metal: special handling
metal_lid_scrap.why: Caps and lids from bottles and jars are recyclable; scrap metal is not.

prep: Broken bottles and jars can still go in blue
drinking_glass_ceramic.why: Drinking glasses, ceramics and tempered glass are landfill.

food_scraps.why: All food, including meat and bones, is compostable.

prep: Branches under 6 in. thick and 4 ft. long
Tape over the contacts of lithium batteries
Clear bag on top of your black bin, or the orange bucket in larger buildings
battery.why: Batteries don't go in any bin. They can start fires.

electronics.why: Electronics are not accepted in any of the three bins.

textile.why: Clothing is not accepted in recycling or compost.

shoes.why: Usable shoes should be reused or donated.

prep: Put it out and run it under water

blister_pack.why: Plastic mixed with other materials goes to landfill.

rope_string.why: Items that can't be recycled or composted go to landfill.

squeezable_tube.why: Toothpaste and cream tubes are on the landfill list.
